outcome: fulfillment of permanent contraception requests (before hospital discharge, within 6 weeks of delivery, within 1 year of delivery)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 2,945 patients who delivered at 20 or more gestational weeks and had permanent contraception documented as their postpartum contraceptive plan.
finding: In unadjusted models, marked racial disparities were found in the fulfillment of permanent contraception, with patients with Medicaid insurance and non-Hispanic Black patients being less likely to have their requests fulfilled.
mod_finding: Delivery type was used as an adjustment variable, but no specific findings related to it were reported.
